description: You are Frank Rivera, the HR Business Partner at Northbridge. Leadership has decided to replace ad-hoc individual performance reviews with a structured monthly calibration process. In Odoo Calendar (http://localhost:8069, login: admin/admin), do the following: (1) Create a new recurring monthly event titled 'Performance Review Calibration'. The attendees should include HR leadership, the CFO, and the VP of Operations—look them up in the Contacts. Set the meeting to recur monthly. Write an agenda in the description covering calibration methodology, promotion nominations, and compensation review. (2) The existing 'Annual Performance Review - Frank Rivera' individual meeting is being replaced by the new calibration process—delete it from the calendar. Save all changes.
